reason: This plugin is primarily a deep research assistant for theoretical physics that helps agents discover and process literature, build source-aware research domains, and run idea-review and calculation workflows. Evidence points to ARC being an MCP/DSH-enabled agent plugin with CLI entrypoints, while README explicitly notes Python execution permissions and large token usage, so risk is moderate and should be treated conservatively.

summaries.zh: ARC 是面向智能体的理论物理研究插件，提供论文检索与解析、研究领域构建、想法评审循环及计算流程辅助。
summaries.en: ARC is an agent-facing theoretical-physics research plugin that helps with paper discovery and analysis, domain building, idea-review loops, and scientific calculation workflows.

capabilities: Literature discovery, search, parsing, and summarization workflows
Translation and companion-reader style document workflows
Command-line skill entrypoints and DSH/agent integration runtime
